**Paris Get‑away Planner – A 7‑Day “City & Culture” Itinerary**

> *Assumptions:*  
> • You’ll arrive on **Monday morning** and depart Sunday evening.  
> • Budget ≈ €1 200–€2 000 per person (mid‑range).  
> • Comfortable walking shoes + light rain jacket (April/May or September/October).  

---

### ✈️ Arrival / Departure

| Time | Activity |
|------|----------|
| **Mon 08:00** | Arrive at Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) via Air France or KLM. Take RER B train → Gare du Nord (~30 min). Check into your hotel. |
| **Sun 18:00** | Depart from CDG using the same route back home. |

*Tip*: Buy a **Navigo Week Pass (€22)** covering all metro/RER lines within zones 1‑5—great value for unlimited rides during your stay.

---

### 🏨 Accommodation Options

| Category | Hotel | Price Range (per night) | Highlights |
|---------|-------|------------------------|------------|
| Luxury | Hôtel Le Meurice | €650+ | Classic Belle Époque décor, Michelin‑starred dining. |
| Mid‑Range | Hotel Ekta | €120–150 | Trendy boutique near Champs‑Élysées, free WiFi. |
| Boutique | La Maison Rose | €90–110 | Charming art‑gallery vibe, central Montmartre location. |
| Budget | Generator Paris | €45–70 | Hostel style, shared kitchen, social events. |

*(All above hotels offer easy access to major sights.)*

---

### 📅 Daily Breakdown

#### Monday – Welcome to Paris
- **Morning:** Freshen up → stroll along Rue Cler market street. Grab croissants & coffee.  
- **Afternoon:** Visit **Louvre Museum** (pre-book skip‑the‑line tickets). Focus on Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo, Egyptian antiquities.  
- **Evening:** Dinner at **Le Comptoir du Relais** (French bistro fare). Walk across Pont des Arts (bridge over Seine).

#### Tuesday – Iconic Landmarks
- **Early Morning:** Eiffel Tower (book early ticket to summit).  
- **Midday:** Picnic at Champ de Mars (pick baguette, cheese, wine).  
- **Late Afternoon:** Stroll through Trocadéro Gardens → photo ops.  
- **Night:** Seine River Cruise (Bateaux Mouches) – see illuminated monuments.

#### Wednesday – Artistic Vibes
- **Morning:** Musée d’Orsay (Impressionist masterpieces).  
- **Lunch:** Café Campana inside museum café.  
- **Afternoon:** Explore Saint-Germain-des-Prés cafés, bookshop Shakespeare & Company.  
- **Dinner:** Brasserie Lipp (classic French brasserie).  

#### Thursday – Hidden Gems & Shopping
- **Morning:** Canal Saint-Martin walk → quirky boutiques, vintage shops.  
- **Brunch:** Chez Gladines (tapas‑style Basque cuisine).  
- **Afternoon:** Palais Garnier opera house tour.  
- **Shopping:** Galeries Lafayette rooftop terrace view.  

#### Friday – Palace & Countryside
- **Full-Day Excursion:** **Versailles** – Château, Hall of Mirrors, gardens. Book guided audio tour. Return late afternoon.  
- **Dinner:** Back in Paris, try **Septime** (reservations required) for modern French tasting menu.

#### Saturday – Cultural Immersion
- **Morning:** Latin Quarter – Panthéon, Sorbonne University campus.  
- **Lunch:** Les Deux Magots (iconic literary cafe).  
- **Afternoon:** Luxembourg Gardens picnic, then explore nearby Musée Rodin.  
- **Evening:** Attend a jazz club in Marigny (e.g., Duc des Lombards).  

#### Sunday – Relaxed Wrap‑Up
- **Breakfast:** Local bakery (pain au chocolat).  
- **Last‑Minute Souvenirs:** Marché aux Puces de Saint-Ouen flea market.  
- **Departure Prep:** Pack souvenirs, double-check passport & visas.  

---

### 🍽️ Must‑Try Foods

| Dish | Where |
|------|-------|
| Croissant & Pain au Chocolat | Any boulangerie (La Pâtisserie des Rêves) |
| Escargot à la Bourguignonne | L’Escargot |
| Coq Au Vin | Le Procope |
| Macarons | Ladurée or Pierre Hermé |
| Crème brûlée | Angelina’s |
| Cheese platter | Fromagerie Barthélémy |

---

### 🚆 Transportation Inside Paris

| Mode | Cost | Notes |
|------|------|-------|
| Metro/Subway | €10.25 single ride | Use contactless payment card. |
| Bus | Same as metro | Night buses cover most routes. |
| Vélib' bike share | €0.35/minute | Great for short distances. |
| Taxi/Uber | €20–40 depending distance | Avoid peak traffic times. |

---

### 💳 Money Matters

- Currency: Euro (€). Credit cards accepted everywhere; carry some cash for small vendors.  
- ATM fees may apply abroad; use Visa/Mastercard ATMs.  
- Tip etiquette: ~10% service charge already included in bills; leave extra only for exceptional service.

---

### 🌐 Practical Tips

| Topic | Advice |
|-------|--------|
| Language | Basic French phrases help; many Parisians speak English but politeness matters (“Bonjour”, “Merci”). |
| Safety | Keep valuables secure; pickpocket risk high around tourist spots. |
| Weather | April/May & Sept/Oct mild; bring umbrella. |
| Connectivity | Free public Wi-Fi available in metros & cafes; purchase local SIM (€10–€20). |
| Visas | EU citizens no visa; US/Canada require ESTA/EU eTA before arrival. |

---

### 🎁 Optional Add‑Ons

| Experience | Approx. Cost | Why it’s worth it |
|-----------|--------------|-------------------|
| Champagne Tasting Tour | €80 | Learn about vineyards & production. |
| Cooking Class (ratatouille, pastry) | €100 | Hands‑on culinary skill. |
| Day Trip to Giverny (Claude Monet’s garden) | €60 | Stunning landscapes, less crowded than Versailles. |
| Private Guided Walking Tour | €50/h | Deep dive into history tailored to interests. |

---

Enjoy your Paris adventure! If you’d like adjustments (shorter trip, different focus areas, higher/lower budget), just let me know—I’m happy to tweak this plan further. Bon voyage!
